description:
NVIDIA is the world leader in GPU Computing. We are passionate about markets including gaming, automotive, vision, HPC, datacenters and networking in addition to our traditional OEM business. NVIDIA is also well positioned as the ‘AI Computing Company’, and NVIDIA GPUs are the brains powering Deep Learning software frameworks, analytics, data centers, and driving autonomous vehicles. We have some of the most experienced and dedicated people in the world working for us. If you are dedicated, forward\-thinking, and if working with hard\-working technical people across countries sounds exciting, this job is for you.
   

  

 NVIDIA is looking for a Software Test and Tools development manager to join the NVIDIA GPU SWQA Team! You will play an exciting role that allows you to manage world class SWQA team and take full ownership of developing automated tests and tools to support high quality product releases . These products are designed to accelerate professional workflow, advanced gaming and enterprise features. You will be involved in developing and implementing automation testing strategies, automation roadmap, for new and existing features to achieve “Zero Defect” goal.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Own all product release quality and work with the engineering team to define and execute project roadmaps, schedules, and deliverables. Manage project risk and mitigate, as necessary. Own providing strategy to automate software functionality, compatibility, security and performance quality coverage.
* Define and drive the overall test engineering strategy for our nvidia GPU products, establishing an engineering\-focused approach to quality encompassing design for scalable test frameworks, tools, and methodologies and lead product testing and engineering efforts across a full\-stack solution
* Design and implement automated tests incorporating AI technologies for NVIDIA's device driver software and SDKs on various Windows and Linux operating systems.
* Build tools/utility/framework in Python \& C\# which would help automate and optimize the testing workflows in GPU domain.
* Prioritizing team assignments and efforts; Supporting and enhancing the QA methodologies to ensure delivery of predictable, high\-quality product releases
* Demonstrate the ability to translate organizational goals to SWQA deliverables
* Be hands\-on to assist in improving process and procedures within the team. Help streamline day\-to\-day operations, workflows and practices. Lead by setting example \- Be a hands\-on manager and develop next line of leadership within the team.
* Helping to define quality practices and metrics which serve as strong predictors for the post\-release customer experience; Building up appropriate manual and automated test inventories to drive efficiency and productivity across the organization
* Timely identification and mitigation of technical and non\-technical risks, helping the team remove impediments; Communicating the status and key quality metrics to leadership teams, and help drive improvement as necessary
* Engage closely with a range of cross functional teams including project management, hardware and software developers, and routinely share statistical data reports.
* Ability to organize and motivate a team, analyze and resolve risks, execute a project plan and communicate status accurately


**What We Need To See**
* BE / BTech / ME / MTech / MS or equivalent experience.
* 10\+ overall years of experience with 5 years of leading and automation test and tools development teams.
* 5\+ years’ experience in core programming languages such as Python/C/C\+\+/Java/Selenium, should have thorough understanding of popular test automation architectures and the best industry practices.
* Prior experience as a technical manager; building and leading more than one project in parallel; with a growth mindset and outcome focused orchestration of deliverables.
* Expert in Windows and Linux OS fundamentals and configuration knowledge – Kernel, Networking, Windowing Systems, Commands and Utilities.
* Prior experience of crafting test plans for New Features and experience in device driver validation
* Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in software automation and manual testing and share your knowledge with the team.
* Experience in working with device driver and ability to translate organization goals into QA goals and good written and verbal communication skills \- concisely articulate knowledge and ideas.
* Excellent analytical skills for triaging, fixing and resolving issues and excellent command on data analysis and reporting; with experience in building Management Information Systems.
* Exposure on utilizing AIML and Agentic AI for accelerating and bringing efficiency in Development and QA workflows
* Ready to work onsite from Pune\-India.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience in leading team of Automation and Manual QA Engineers.
* Background with using AI Tools in Development and QA workflow
* Experience implementing automation for system software/SOC products.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU hardware, Graphics and Display Concepts – Geometry, Transform, Lighting, Rasterization, Occlusion, Texture \& Filtering, Anti\-Aliasing, Composition, Refresh Rates, V\-Sync, Frame Buffer, Overlays, Display Timing Parameters, Display Heads, OpenGL, GSYNC, DLSS.

description:
**Position –** 
 Manager, International Expansion
 



**Location:** 
 Pune (Work from Office)
 



**Department:** 
 International Business
 



**Working Days:** 
 6 Days a Week
 



  





**About Frido** 




 Frido is a Pune\-based mobility and wellness brand dedicated to improving the way people move, sit, walk, and live. Our product portfolio includes ergonomic chairs, electric wheelchairs, mobility scooters, cushions, pillows, footwear, and other wellness solutions. As we continue our growth journey, we are looking for a dynamic professional to lead our international business expansion.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The
 **Manager – International Expansion** 
 will be responsible for driving Frido's global growth by identifying new market opportunities, developing and executing
 **Go\-to\-Market (GTM) strategies** 
 , establishing international distribution networks, and building strategic partnerships. This role requires strong commercial acumen, market entry expertise, and the ability to scale business across international markets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and execute Frido's international expansion strategy.
* Identify high\-potential countries, market opportunities, and growth segments.
* Build and manage relationships with distributors, dealers, importers, and channel partners.
* Drive export sales for Frido's mobility, ergonomic, and wellness product portfolio.
* Develop go\-to\-market strategies for new international markets.
* Manage partnerships with global distributors and healthcare channels.
* Coordinate with regulatory and compliance teams to ensure smooth market entry.
* Work closely with Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, and Marketing for international business execution.
* Lead pricing strategy, product positioning, and competitive benchmarking across markets.
* Explore opportunities on international B2B and B2C marketplaces such as Amazon Global, Noon, Walmart Marketplace, etc.
* Participate in international trade fairs, exhibitions, and networking events.
* Track market trends, customer insights, competitor activities, and business performance.
* Achieve international sales and revenue targets.



  





**Required Skills** 



* International Business Development
* Export Sales
* Distributor \& Channel Management
* Global Market Research
* Strategic Partnerships
* International Negotiation
* Market Entry Strategy
* Cross\-functional Stakeholder Management
* Commercial \& Pricing Strategy
* International Trade \& Export Documentation
* Strong Presentation \& Communication Skills
* Advanced Excel \& CRM Tools



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* 7–10 years of experience in International Business Development, Export Sales, or Global Expansion.
* Experience in consumer products, healthcare, medical devices, ergonomic furniture, wellness products, or mobility solutions.
* Proven experience in expanding business across regions such as the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, or Africa.
* Experience managing distributors and international channel partners.
* Knowledge of export regulations, logistics, and international trade practices.



**Qualification** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Healthcare, or a related field.
* MBA in International Business, Marketing, or Sales preferred.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* International revenue growth
* New countries launched
* Distributor/channel partner acquisition
* Export order value
* Market expansion projects completed
* Partner retention and satisfaction
* International gross margin
* Sales forecast accuracy



  





**Why Join Frido?** 



* Opportunity to build Frido's global presence from India.
* Work with an innovative and fast\-growing mobility and wellness brand.
* High ownership role with strategic business impact.
* Collaborative and entrepreneurial work culture.



  





**Ideal Companies to Target** 



* Healthcare \& Medical Devices: Ottobock, Sunrise Medical, Invacare, Drive DeVilbiss, Arjo
* Ergonomic Furniture: Herman Miller, Steelcase, Haworth, Humanscale
* Consumer \& Wellness: Tynor, Vissco, Decathlon, Philips Healthcare, Medline
* D2C Consumer Brands with international expansion experience
* Export houses dealing in healthcare, furniture, wellness, or consumer products



  





**Interested candidates can share their resumes at \-** 
 kiran.m@myfrido.com.

Now Hiring: Luxury Sales Executives : ONLY FOR CANDIDATES BASED IN PUNE
 



 Location: The Pavilion, Pune
 



 Salary range: ₹20,000 – ₹25,000
 



  





 At Gautam Banerjee Jewellery, we create jewellery that is timeless, artistic, and deeply personal. As our brand continues to grow, we are looking for poised, polished, and passionate individuals to join our in\-store sales team at The Pavilion, Pune.
 



 This is more than a retail sales role, it is an opportunity to represent one of India’s distinguished designer jewellery brands and deliver an exceptional luxury experience to every client who walks into our store.
 



 We are seeking individuals who understand elegance, communicate with confidence, and naturally build meaningful relationships with clients.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



 • Deliver a refined and personalised customer experience aligned with the GBJ brand philosophy
 



 • Assist clients in discovering jewellery pieces suited to their style, occasion, and preferences
 



 • Build strong client relationships and nurture repeat clientele through exceptional service
 



 • Achieve individual and store sales targets while maintaining premium service standards
 



 • Present jewellery collections with confidence, sophistication, and product understanding
 



 • Maintain impeccable visual merchandising and store presentation standards
 



 • Handle customer queries, customisation requests, and after\-sales interactions professionally
 



 • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure seamless customer experience and inventory management
 



 • Represent the brand gracefully during exhibitions, launches, and special events
 



  





 What We Are Looking For:
 



 • 2\-4 years of experience in jewellery retail or luxury retail sales
 



 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 



 • A polished, well\-groomed, and presentable personality
 



 • Confidence in client interaction and relationship building
 



 • Strong understanding of customer service etiquette in a premium retail environment
 



 • Passion for fashion, jewellery, styling, and luxury experiences
 



 • Self\-driven, ambitious, and sales\-oriented mindset
 



 • Fluency in English and Hindi (additional languages are a plus)
 



 Why Join Gautam Banerjee Jewellery?
 



 • Opportunity to work with a growing luxury designer jewellery brand
 



 • Exposure to premium clientele and high\-value sales interactions
 



 • Elegant and inspiring work environment
 



 • Career growth within a creatively driven luxury brand
 



 • Salary range: ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month, along with attractive performance\-based incentives 
 



  





 If you believe you have the sophistication, confidence, and personality to thrive in luxury jewellery retail, we would love to hear from you.
 



  





 Send your resume to:
 **enquiry@gautambanerjee.in**
